usedFor: Evenium holds event guests, and MSG91 sends each one an email through your MSG91 account using “Send a Mail”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Guests Added” in Evenium, then “Send a Mail” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: New guests get a templated email as soon as they are added to the event.

watchOut: A mail to a guest reaches someone outside, so it waits in Needs you for your approval first.
